title: finding(plugin-detail): `DetailSection` reads `section.hideEmpty`, but the `detail-section` node does not declare it, so an authored `hideEmpty` is warned `unknown-prop` and dropped at render
body:
Filing-gate category: ③ a trap: the renderer honours a key the node's declared `inputs` omit, so the validator steers an author away from a working key (class c). Reader: triage first (route and grade). ⚠️ Widening an authoring surface is a product decision, so this is likely a director-ruling card like its sibling objectui#9529.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#9529 (PR objectui#10484). ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Fact (the dev's probe at `274e14af4`, relayed, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

- `DetailSection` (`packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`) reads `section.hideEmpty === true`, the all-empty hide that objectui#8603 restored. objectui#9529 measured the node's gap at `bbc9dc3`, before that read existed, so it counted exactly one member.
- The `detail-section` registration (`packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`) and `DETAIL_SECTION_NODE_INPUTS` (`DetailSectionNode.tsx`) do not declare `hideEmpty`, even after PR objectui#10484 adds `icon`.
- The probe used a live manifest built as `page.tsx` builds it. An authored `hideEmpty` on the node draws `unknown-prop`. `DetailSectionNode` then passes it as a host prop, which `DetailSection` ignores, so it is dropped at render.
- Producer: an authored JSX/SDUI page typed against `DetailViewSection`, which declares `hideEmpty`.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- Same class and same site as objectui#9529 (ruled there: declare, because the renderer already honours the key). The dev notes one extra wrinkle for whoever rules: the omitted default for `hideEmpty` differs between `record:details` and `detail-view`.
- Seam: `types:DetailViewSection.hideEmpty` → `registry:detail-section inputs` → `renderer:DetailSection`.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). `hideEmpty` ⇒ PR objectui#10484 (the source) and two unrelated closed items. `DETAIL_SECTION_NODE_INPUTS` ⇒ objectui#9529 and PR objectui#10484. Must-hit control `detail-section` ⇒ 4 hits.

Dedupe words: `detail-section hideEmpty` · `DETAIL_SECTION_NODE_INPUTS hideEmpty` · `section.hideEmpty undeclared-input`
